programme.title: ABC News Mornings
programme.desc: Stay in the know with what's going on this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Kathryn Robinson.

programme.title: Four Corners
programme.desc: The aged care algorithm - Anne Connolly investigates the secretive and controversial new method of assessing funding. Experts warn that a policy meant to fix aged care could actually cost both the elderly and the taxpayer.

programme.title: Foreign Correspondent
programme.desc: On the tropical Honduran island of Roatan lies Prospera, a controversial libertarian proto state where billionaires can avoid taxes and government rules and biohackers try to cheat death with experimental medical treatments.

programme.title: Back Roads
programme.desc: Guest presenter Paul West heads to Barcaldine - where ghost stories, legendary strikes and outback art collide. Discover the iconic 'Tree of Knowledge' in a celebration of resilience, reinvention, and true Aussie spirit.

programme.title: ABC News At Noon
programme.desc: The leading news at lunchtime. Ros Childs brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

programme.title: National Press Club
programme.desc: Daniel Mulino, Assistant Treasurer and Minister for Financial Services, addresses the National Press Club on the topic "Protecting Consumers and the Promise of Superannuation in an Evolving Financial System".

programme.title: Media Watch
programme.desc: Troubles are mounting for Meta as a court case exposes its role in a mental health crisis. Another "Outback" doco caught staging scenes while receiving public funding. Plus the family struggling to buy a home - or are they?

programme.title: Parliament Question Time
programme.desc: The sitting week in parliament continues with coverage of Question Time from the House of Representatives.

programme.title: Fake Or Fortune?
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and Philip Mould investigate more cases of art world mystery, intrigue and deception. Is a still life painting by William Nicholson bought in 2006 for 165,000 real or an elaborate fake?

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: When Julia Ogden's father passes away, she uncovers an unexpected truth behind his death - and his life. Meanwhile, Brackenreid must take over for Murdoch in the investigation of a murder amongst a group of geniuses.

programme.title: Long Lost Family: What Happened Next
programme.desc: Davina and Nicky revisit Maureen who discovered a brother and sister that she previously knew nothing about. Plus Fiona, whose reunion with her sister brought the revelation that her biological mother was still alive.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The Roadshow is in the Welsh capital city of Cardiff based at its iconic castle. Its lavish interior is just one of the surprises in store. The castle grounds provide the perfect setting for a journey into the past.
